set.body: Consolidate ParcelValues/ParcelData around locus4s Field[P,A] on the exact realization parcel owner. Retain ownership in typed reducer results and derive display records from authoritative metadata. Provide checked canonical-key and convention-qualified source-ID alignment; explicit duplicate/unknown/missing policies; consistent scalar/series mask, missing-data and empty-support policy. Avoid a second generic field/domain algebra. Acceptance: independent neuroatlas key-alignment fixtures, foreign/reordered owner failures, both-platform tests and compiled workflow examples.
set.title: Atlas: make parcel fields authoritative with checked keyed alignment
